name: Sedris
description: Once the good king of Vithia who submitted to demons and became the most powerful lich warlord on Grixis.

description_citations.text: "Grixis". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Sedris, king of Vithia, submits to demons' temptation, hands thousands of innocents over to them and becomes a lich; the paladins flee and Vithia is overrun.
timeline.quote: Sedris handed thousands of innocents over to the demons, killed his own family and advisors

citation.text: "Grixis", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Vithia's capital is transformed into the greatest necropolis on the plane, still ruled by Sedris.
timeline.quote: Sedris still rules this dark city of the dead, as the most powerful lich warlord on the plane.

citation.text: "Grixis", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
